// Non-compliant fixture — contains an undeclared read. Used by the
// synthetic-module negative test to verify the analyzer reports a
// diagnostic for an undeclared in-scope read.
//
// File extension is `.go.txt` so it is not compiled as part of `go test
// ./...`. The synthetic-module test scaffolding rewrites it to `.go`
// inside a temp directory before running the lint.
package settlement

type Payload struct {
	TaskID   string
	WorkerID string
}

func ReadNonCompliant(p *Payload) (string, string) {
	a := p.TaskID   // declared at line 15
	b := p.WorkerID // NOT declared — must be flagged
	return a, b
}
